name: agent-builder-git-grant-reconciled
body:
Reconciliation record (spec-writer) for `worktree-write-scope`, surfaced by the `feedback-13` navigator-branch reconciliation and treated as UNTRUSTED until confirmed.

SOURCE STATEMENT (finding): `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` grants a blanket `git branch *` AND a blanket `git remote *` in its frontmatter `bash:` block, yet `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow`, `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main`, and `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` describe these as "the read-only git patterns" — the same defect class as the navigator blanket `git branch *` (feedback-13).

VERIFIED against the graph + template. `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` —implemented-by→ `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` (File node, 504 lines on this branch). Its frontmatter `bash:` block lines 30-42 grants `"git branch *": allow` (line 38) and `"git remote *": allow` (line 39); rule 2 (lines 301-309) calls `git status/log/branch/remote/ls-files` "read-only". The finding is CORRECT: `git branch *` admits ref-writing forms (`git branch -f <branch> <sha>`, `git branch -D`, `git branch -m`) and `git remote *` admits config-mutating forms (`git remote add`/`remove`/`set-url`/`rename`/`set-head`), which are not read-only. The three spec nodes' "read-only git patterns" wording was inaccurate.

NO MUTATING VERB IS NEEDED. The agent-builder's job is detect-stack → interview → scaffold/update `.opencode/agents/**` on the main checkout → `git add` + `git commit` there. It reads git history and the remote to learn conventions (e.g. for the optional release-agent interview). It never needs to rewrite a branch ref or mutate remote config; push/tag belong to the optional `release-agent` (as `ask`). So the mutating forms are forbidden, not justified.

RESOLUTION [autonomous]. Narrowed the agent-builder's read-only git grant set to genuinely read-only forms, stated identically across the requirement, its attaches-to constraint, and the component:
- KEEP `git status *`, `git log *`, `git ls-files *`.
- REPLACE blanket `git branch *` with the single exact inspection pattern `git branch --show-current` (prints the checked-out branch; takes no ref-writing option).
- REPLACE blanket `git remote *` with the exact read-only forms `git remote -v` and `git remote show *` (list / inspect a remote; neither mutates config).
- The write carve-out is unchanged: `git add *` + `git commit *`; never push/tag.
This mirrors the already-reconciled navigator rule (`requirements.constraint.main-integration-via-merge-gate-only`, `requirements.requirement.navigator-no-unguarded-main-git`), which narrowed the navigator's blanket `git branch *` to `git branch --show-current`. The agent-builder additionally gets the read-only remote forms — it legitimately inspects the remote for the release-agent interview, and `git remote -v`/`git remote show *` are genuinely read-only.

SPINE UNCHANGED. `requirements.user.navigator-agent` ⊃ requirement —drives→ `domain.entity.agent-scaffold-flow` —realised-by→ `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` —implemented-by→ `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`; the constraint still `attaches-to` the requirement. Only bodies were amended in place (no node/edge added or removed).

CODE FOLLOW-UP (separate plan task; `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` is in this change-set's scope, alongside codebase-navigator.md and AGENTS.md):
- Line 38: `"git branch *": allow` → `"git branch --show-current": allow`.
- Line 39: `"git remote *": allow` → two entries `"git remote -v": allow` and `"git remote show *": allow`.
- Line 304 (rule 2 body): "Read-only `git status/log/branch/remote/ls-files` are allowed" → name the exact patterns `git status/log/ls-files`, `git branch --show-current`, `git remote -v`/`git remote show *`, and state that the blanket `git branch *`/`git remote *` are deliberately NOT granted (amend this rule in the same task that adds `git add *`/`git commit *` and rewrites rule 2 to permit add+commit).
- Line 269 (non-negotiable constraint 2 header/intro) uses the same "read-only `git status/log/branch/remote/ls-files`" shorthand; update it to match.
Acceptance a reviewer can check: the agent-builder frontmatter grants none of a blanket `git branch` or blanket `git remote`; its read-only git grants are exactly `git status *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git remote -v`, `git remote show *`, `git ls-files *`; its only git mutation is `git add *`/`git commit *`.

Out of scope: the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts regenerated out-of-band from the released binary after this change-set is released (merge alone is insufficient — the template is `include_str!` product source), never edited by a change-set.
